keyMessages: 1. Trudy is forecast to strengthen as it moves near the coast of southwestern and west-central Mexico tonight and Sunday. Damaging hurricane-force winds are likely within the hurricane warning area.
2. A dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves is likely in areas of onshore winds within the warning areas.

3. Heavy rainfall associated with Trudy will impact the southwest Mexican coast between Guerrero and Nayarit through the weekend. This rainfall may produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides along and near the southwest Mexican coast in Michoacán, Colima, and Jalisco, especially in areas along steep terrain.
4. Large swells are affecting portions of the coast of southwestern Mexico and will spread northward through the weekend, causing life-threatening surf and rip current conditions.
